lab.studioText: Create and edit your remixes: parts, layers, drums and melody.
lab.intro: Play, mix and make music that always sounds good.

capas.title: Layers
capas.text: switch kick, snare, hi-hat, bass, chords and melody on and off (DJ inside)

piano.title: Magic piano
piano.text: each tap is the next note of a melody that fits the style

coro.title: Choir
coro.text: drag one voice and two more harmonise by themselves

circulo.title: Rhythm circle
circulo.text: tap the rings to place hits; wheels to spread them (3 against 4)

remixes.title: Remixes
remixes.text: pick a song and perform its parts: intro, build-up, drop and outro

capas.phrase: Tap the circles to switch layers on and off. It starts with the rhythm; you add the rest.
capas.pad: (gamepad: A B X Y, LB, RB)

piano.phrase: Tap anywhere: each tap is the next note. You set the rhythm.

coro.phrase: Drag your finger: high up, low down. The other voices harmonise by themselves.

circulo.phraseDots: Tap the rings to add or remove hits. Each instrument draws its own shape.
circulo.phraseWheels: Drag around a ring: more turns, more hits, evenly spread.

dj.hint: DJ · hold and move; release with the filter closed and the drop lands

remix.phrase: Tap a part: it comes in on the next bar and stays until you pick another. Inside, switch layers on and off.
remix.phraseAuto: Tap a part: it comes in on the next bar. When it ends it moves on to the next by itself (turn «Auto» off to stay on one). Use the DJ inside.
remix.unverified: notes from memory: check against the score

start.secure: The mic needs a secure connection (https).
start.withMic: With the mic, headphones work best.
start.denied: Microphone permission denied. Enable it in your browser settings for this site and try again.

part.proposeNone: This part needs a rhythm first (drums).
part.max8: A remix has at most 8 parts.
part.many: This part has more than 4 layers at once: all are shown, but it sounds better with fewer.
part.singNoScale: The song has no scale: I'll ask when you sing
part.singDone: Done: a new melody in this part. Fix it in the Organ.
part.singNothing: No note heard: nothing was created.
part.singNoMic: The microphone could not be opened.
part.singHeadphones: Headphones needed: the backing leaks into the mic.
part.singFull: This part already has {n} melodies: delete one first.

drums.title: Drums
drums.help: Tap to add or remove hits; it loops with the part. With 🎤 you can say “boom · tss · ts” and then fix it here.

lock.on: part locked: tap to let the song move on
lock.off: lock the part in a loop

organ.title: Melody
organ.pianoAria: magic piano: you play the rhythm and the app picks the notes
organ.helpHalf: play at half speed; it snaps to the grid and stops by itself at the end
organ.helpPiano: tap the rhythm anywhere: each tap is the next note
organ.timeAria: loop time: when paused, drag the playhead
organ.help: Tap an empty cell to place a note (drag right to lengthen it) · tap a note to hear it · drag it to move it, or outside the box to delete it · pull its end to change its length
organ.chordsHint: several notes at once: tapping adds another note on that step and tapping a note removes it
organ.tiesHint: a note can cross the bar line
organ.namesHint: C D E on the rows and the name of the note you tap

remixes.title: My songs
remixes.newConfirm: What you have now isn't saved. Start a new song?
remixes.pasteHere: Paste the text of a song, a backup or a link here
remixes.importedRejected: {n} were not valid and were discarded
remixes.errFormat: Not a coderbeats file (a .json is expected).
remixes.privacy: Your songs live only in this browser: they are never uploaded anywhere.

settings.advancedHint: Compose mode, effects, voice, fine settings and more
settings.flowHint: finger trail and veins (switches off by itself if slow)
settings.voiceHelp: Sing “na” while the loop plays and it snaps to the style's scale. Better with headphones.
settings.voiceBlocked: No effect: the mic hears the speakers. Use headphones and reload the app.
settings.imageFine: fine adjustment of the image delay
settings.imageHelp: If the needle and balls run ahead of the sound (Bluetooth headphones), raise the setting. Automatic: {auto} ms from your calibration · fine adjustment {fine} ms. Saved on this device. With Bluetooth the delay can vary: if it drifts again, adjust it again.
settings.syncHelp: One click per second and a dot that lights up. If the dot lights up before the click, raise the setting; if after, lower it.
settings.previewHelp: your remix builds itself, step by step (mic locked); when it ends or stops, everything is as it was.
settings.videoHelp: records the screen without buttons, with the app's audio (not the mic).
settings.pilotHelp: the autopilot builds the dembow demo with a ghost finger (replaces what you have).
settings.convertHelp: from a loop to the style's intro, build-up, drop and outro (with “undo”).
settings.guideHelp: the first minute: boom · tss · ts, and your hits appear (with an empty song).
settings.freeHelp: A group of one part that plays alongside the remix. On the map, a tap switches it on or off.
settings.syncMelodyHint: the spiral lands on the base's beat
settings.simpleHelp: the front page: pick a style, play the melody with your finger and add rhythm with your voice.
settings.addMelodyHelp: a part to play the melody with your finger, like a synth (up/down = note, sides = filter).
settings.gestures: Drag vertically over the water for the filter and horizontally for the space. Two fingers: backing on/off. Tap a loop to mute it; hold it to delete it.
settings.soundsDefault: Sounds: default model (not accurate? tune it to your voice)
settings.bleed: The mic hears the speakers ({ms} ms). Use headphones.
settings.videoHint: records the screen without buttons, with the app's audio (not the mic).

info.sound: The drum sound: Electronic, Vinyl or 808.
info.scale: Notes snap to the style's scale on their own, so they never sound wrong. Best left on.
info.bg: How the bass and chords come in: manual (you switch them on), progressive (they come in by themselves as you add things), full (always) or none.
info.phrase: How long what you record with your voice lasts: exactly one bar, or until you go quiet.
info.close: How much silence it takes to consider the phrase finished.
info.maxPhrase: The longest a recorded phrase can be, in bars.
info.repeat: If you record an instrument that already exists: “replace” swaps it and “complete” adds hits to it.
info.suggestions: The app proposes a melody and variations based on what you do. Off, it proposes nothing.
info.production: Adds a little swing and volume changes so it sounds more human (beta).
info.flow: The finger trail and the veins in the water. Switches off by itself if the phone is slow.
info.voiceMelody: Sing “na” with the music and your voice becomes a melody in the style's scale. Better with headphones (beta).
info.motion: Tilting the phone moves the image.
info.metronome: One click per beat: handy when recording with your voice or the Organ.
info.imageDelay: Adjusts how late the image is so it matches the sound; useful with Bluetooth headphones.
info.warmth: Makes the sound warmer and softer.
info.demo: Loads the style's demo rhythm (replaces what you have).
info.preview: Your remix builds itself, step by step; when it ends, everything is as it was.
info.video: Records the screen without buttons, with the app's audio (not the mic).
info.pilot: A ghost finger builds the dembow demo (replaces what you have).
info.convert: Turns a rhythm into a remix with the style's intro, build-up, drop and outro (can be undone).
info.guide: Repeats the first-minute guide and the tutorial.
info.free: A group of one part that plays at the same time as the remix.
info.syncMelody: The melody's spiral lands on the rhythm's beat.
info.addMelody: A part to play the melody with your finger, like a synth.
info.calibration: Tunes the app to your voice and your headphones' delay. Only needed if you use the mic.
info.drop: DJ effect: the rhythm and bass cut out and come back with a bang.
info.fresh: Clears what you have and starts from scratch.

glue.label: Techno compressor
glue.info: Glues the mix together more (ratio 3, high threshold) so techno sounds tight. Off: it sounds as always. It affects everything that plays, including your songs.

eq.label: Techno EQ
eq.info: Cuts below 30 Hz and lifts 2–5 kHz (+2.5 dB): more sparkle, less useless sub. Off: it sounds as always. It affects everything that plays.

meter.label: Output level
meter.hot: Near the ceiling (−1 dB): turn it down so you don't clip.

studio.durationOver: the remix lasts {time}, more than 2 minutes
studio.styleAsk: It now plays in {style}. Keep your song or load the demo? The demo replaces what you have.
studio.demoWhy: a ready-made beat to play over
studio.toLabAria: play this remix in the Lab

about.intro: coderbeats · play, mix and make music that always sounds good.
about.fork: Open source · fork it on GitHub
about.licensePost: You can use, study, modify and share it; if you offer a modified version as a network service, you must offer its source code to whoever uses it.
about.sourcePost: the code you generate with your music is yours; your recordings stay on your device.
about.share: When sharing: songs with the acoustic drums, the techno kit or the recorded guitar play fully in the app; the code on strudel.cc uses strudel’s own sounds.
about.marks: “808” and “Roland” are trademarks of their owners and only describe the sound. Details of each sample in
about.privacy: No accounts, no analytics. Your music and settings stay on your device; the audio of your voice never leaves it.
about.convert: Want to bring your own melodies? The repo has a notes converter and an agent to help you (public domain or original music only).
